## 🌟 End-to-End Causal Execution Chain (The Complete Download Pipeline)

This is the chronological, step-by-step causal chain captured during portal execution.
AI agents MUST follow this provenance chain to automate official document delivery without drift:

| Step | Pipeline Stage | Actor / Component | Call Site / Action | Purpose & Artifact |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Step 1** | User Trigger | DOM Event | `click` on button | User clicks "Preview / Download" button in the portal UI |
| **Step 2** | Controller Scope | AngularJS Controller | `Portal Controller.$scope.downloadPrePdf()` | Native controller method initiates download pipeline & sets filing parameters |
| **Step 3** | Server Exchange | XHR / Fetch API | `/services/api/ustatus` | Portal fetches raw taxpayer JSON data payload from authenticated endpoint |
| **Step 4** | In-Memory Assembly | Official Controller Script | `gstr3bctrl.js` (150KB+ compiler) | Controller formats statutory circular tables (Tables 3.1, 3.1.1, 3.2, 4, 5, 6.1) |
| **Step 5** | Document Compilation | `pdfMake.createPdf()` | Client-side compilation engine | Compiles assembled layout into multi-page document structure in memory |
| **Step 6** | Binary Blob Creation | `pdfDoc.getBlob()` | Native Blob assembly | Assembles official multi-page PDF binary (39472 bytes) |
| **Step 7** | Physical File Delivery | Browser Anchor / SaveAs | `GSTR3B_22AAIFT4081E1ZE_052026.pdf` | Browser writes authentic government document to local disk |

> 🎯 **ZERO-DRIFT AUTOMATION RULE**:
> **Automate by triggering Step 2 directly via `angular.element().scope().downloadPrePdf("FIL")`.**
> Never skip Steps 2-4 by hardcoding a mock docDefinition! Portal circulars and calculation rules update frequently; static docDefs cause incomplete/fraudulent document generation.
